name: gray-scott

equations.diff[U, t]: diff[U, x, x; wrap] + diff[U, y, y; wrap] + U * U * V - (0.037 + 0.06) * U
equations.diff[V, t]: 2 * (diff[V, x, x; wrap] + diff[V, y, y; wrap]) - U * U * V + (0.037 * (1 - V))

conditions.U(t: 0, x, y): sphere(pos: #(x, y), center: #(0.5, 0.5), radius: 0.2, inside: -1.0, outside: 0.0)

displays: grid(plane: fn(x, y) => U(t, x, y), start: #(0, 0), end: #(1, 1), steps: #(50, 50))
